nodes.label: Patient was admitted for evaluation of low-grade fever
A 55-year-old man had severe dilated cardiomyopathy and a left ventricular assist device (HeartMate II) implanted four years previously
Serum creatinine increased from 124 μmol/L to 354 μmol/L over two months; urinary protein excretion was 2.2 g/day with microhaematuria
Blood cultures were positive for Corynebacterium jeikeium
Renal biopsy showed mesangial IgM/C1q/C3 deposits without subepithelial humps
Renal biopsy showed focal segmental necrotising immune-complex glomerulonephritis with crescents
PR3-ANCA was elevated and MPO-ANCA was negative
Corynebacterium jeikeium LVAD infection causing infection-related glomerulonephritis
LVAD infection-related immune-complex glomerulonephritis with crescents
FDG-PET/CT shows increased FDG activity at the driveline, pocket, and outflow cannula
Active Corynebacterium jeikeium LVAD infection involving the driveline, pocket, and outflow cannula
Renal biopsy showed subendothelial and mesangial immune-complex deposits
